en: Thank you, Shuichi!
Huh? For what?

For inviting Gonta!
Gonta very, very happy!

This maybe first time Gonta spend free time
with anyone!

So Gonta will work hard!
Treat Shuichi like true gentleman!

Ah, it's okay, Gonta. You don't have to be
so...intense. Just talking is fine.

No, is not fine!
Shuichi invited Gonta!

B-But...what should we do for fun?
Think Gonta, think...
Oh, Gonta know! Come, we race!
Race?

Gonta good at running! Running full speed
through forest so much fun!

Plus, feel good to run like wind.
Maybe nice change of pace.

<CLT=cltMIND>He claims to be a gentleman,
but now he wants to race?

...Alright, Gonta.
If you want to race, let's race.
Okay! Then, let's go!

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta grabbed my hand and pulled
me firmly, and I ran along behind him.

G-Gonta!
You're running too fast!

<CLT=cltMIND>I had forgotten that Gonta was raised in
the wild, of course he's athletic!

Not yet! To run like wind, gotta run way
faster!
Wh-What are you talking about!?

<CLT=cltMIND>After being dragged along by Gonta,
I began to trip over my feet.

<CLT=cltMIND>Exhausted, I began to stagger, and unluckily
the stairs to the basement were right there...
<CLT=cltMIND>Whoa, I'm gonna fall!
Shuichi!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I heard Gonta shout and
felt my body being pulled back.
Whoa!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*slam!*

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta yanked me back toward him,
and when I hit his chest, we both fell over.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Or so I thought.
Gonta didn't even flinch when I hit him.
Shuichi...okay?

Ah, I'm okay...that was close.
Thank you for saving me.

No thank Gonta... Gonta make Shuichi run...
This all Gonta's fault...
I had fun
Why did you invite me?
I apologize for being so much trouble
Are you unsure of something?

Sorry...
Gonta not very fun after all...
No, Gonta, I had fun!
Really?

Of course! It's been a long time since I've
had to run that fast... It felt good, in a way.
A nice change of pace.
Oh! Then, Gonta glad Shuichi had fun...
Gonta...

Why did you invite me?
Kaito looks like he'd be better at running...

Invite Kaito? You sure?
Gonta not wanna make trouble...

Ah, I think...as long as you don't
force him to come, it will be alright.

Ah, um, Gonta...
I had a lot of fun, running with you.
I apologize for being so much trouble.

Why Shuichi sorry!?
Gonta mess up, not Shuichi!

You're not at fault, Gonta,
I was the one that tripped.

Besides, it was a lot of fun to go running.
A nice change of pace.
Shuichi...!

I'd like to do this again sometime.
The next time I need another change of pace.

O-Okay! Then Gonta wait!
Invite Gonta any time!

Gonta do anything for Shuichi!
Gonta protect you! Like gentleman!
<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is brimming with positivity.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Gonta really is pure.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Gonta's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Smiling to myself at Gonta's innocence,
I returned to my room.
